title: Web Developer
summary:
Web Developer and Designer at a U.S.-based web agency, building, maintaining, and troubleshooting WordPress websites across a wide range of client projects. My work covers custom themes and functionality, Gutenberg blocks, ACF, WooCommerce, Gravity Forms, Kadence and Elementor builds, third-party integrations, React-based features, performance optimization, and ongoing maintenance.

I also work across the broader technical side of client sites, including PHP and WordPress upgrades, plugin and theme conflicts, hosting and deployment issues, email and SMTP configuration, API integrations, responsive fixes, accessibility, and production troubleshooting. Alongside development, I contribute UI/UX design and take projects from requirements and design through development, launch, and support.
achievements: Built complete WordPress websites using both custom and block-based approaches
Developed and extended the WordHerd custom theme framework
Created custom Gutenberg blocks, reusable components, and WordPress functionality
Integrated React and third-party services into WordPress projects
Diagnosed and resolved complex issues across WordPress, PHP, plugins, hosting, email, and performance
Designed responsive interfaces and client-facing experiences in Figma
